title: nf-core/epitopeprediction pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces
sample.description: Custom sample name. This entry will be identical for multiple sequencing libraries/runs from the same sample. Can be an integer or a string without spaces.

alleles.errorMessage: Alleles must be provided as string or file with extension '.txt'. Please check the documentation for more information.
alleles.description: A string that consists of the patient's alleles (separated by ';'), or a full path to a allele '.txt' file where each allele is saved on a row.

mhc_class.errorMessage: The MHC class must be provided. Valid values: 'I' or 'II'
mhc_class.description: Specifies the MHC class for which the prediction should be performed. Valid values are: `I` or `II`.

filename.errorMessage: Variants/proteins/peptides of a sample must be provided and have one of the following extensions: '.vcf', '.vcf.gz', '.tsv', '.fasta'
filename.description: Path to a variant, protein or peptide file ('.vcf', '.vcf.gz','.fasta', 'tsv')

germline_vcf.errorMessage: The germline_vcf (if provided) must be a path to a '.vcf' or '.vcf.gz' file.
germline_vcf.description: Optional. Germline calls for the same patient, used only as context so that neoepitope windows carry the patient's own variants. Not scanned for candidates.

tumor_sample.errorMessage: The tumor_sample (if provided) must be a sample name without spaces.
tumor_sample.description: Optional. Name of the tumour sample as it appears in the VCF header line (e.g. TUMOR for Strelka). Needed when the VCF holds more than one sample; leave empty for single-sample VCFs.
